_comment: Player-facing text for trees.json. Ids, menu labels, previous values, layers, tiles and house portals come from spirit_trees.verified.json; everything here is curated display text checked against the OSRS Wiki (pages listed under 'sources'; https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/<page>, read with ?action=raw on 2026-10-04). Printable ASCII only. label <= 24 characters (the map label), lockedHint <= 32 (why a grey row is grey). Requirement lines start with Quest:, Skill:, Unlock:, Item: or Diary:. poi: 3-6 useful things nearby; notes: 0-3 short tips. Edit here, then run tools/build_trees.py.

requirements: Quest: Tree Gnome Village (every spirit tree)

TREE_GNOME_VILLAGE.name: Tree Gnome Village
TREE_GNOME_VILLAGE.label: Tree Gnome Village
TREE_GNOME_VILLAGE.area: Centre of the Gnome Maze, Tree Gnome Village (Kandarin)
poi: King Bolren and the gnome village
Elkoy, who takes you to the maze entrance and back
notes: The tree is the quick way into the middle of the maze.
Hard clue: the challenge scroll answer is 13112221.

GNOME_STRONGHOLD.name: Gnome Stronghold
GNOME_STRONGHOLD.label: Gnome Stronghold
GNOME_STRONGHOLD.area: Tree Gnome Stronghold, south of the Grand Tree (north-west Kandarin)
poi: Grand Tree, with the gnome glider on its top level
notes: Travelling from this tree also needs The Grand Tree; arriving here does not.
A Slayer ring teleport to the Stronghold Slayer Cave lands close to this tree.

BATTLEFIELD_OF_KHAZARD.name: Battlefield of Khazard
BATTLEFIELD_OF_KHAZARD.label: Battlefield of Khazard
BATTLEFIELD_OF_KHAZARD.area: The Battlefield, just south of West Ardougne (Kandarin)
poi: Ourania Cave (ZMI altar) to the west
Tree Gnome Village to the south
notes: Ardougne cloak to the Monastery, then a short walk north-west: the cheapest way to this tree.
danger: Gnome and Khazard troops fight here; catapult shots on the northern half hit for up to 3.

GRAND_EXCHANGE.name: Grand Exchange
GRAND_EXCHANGE.label: Grand Exchange
GRAND_EXCHANGE.area: North-east corner of the Grand Exchange, Varrock (Misthalin)
poi: Agility shortcut tunnel west to Edgeville (21 Agility)
notes: Before 83 Farming the quickest way onto the network: ring of wealth, or Varrock Teleport's GE option (medium Varrock Diary).

FELDIP_HILLS.name: Feldip Hills
FELDIP_HILLS.label: Feldip Hills
FELDIP_HILLS.area: South-west corner of the Feldip Hills, next to the Myths' Guild
poi: Wrath Altar, through the Myths' Guild basement
Corsair Cove and its bank (The Corsair Curse)

PRIFDDINAS.name: Prifddinas
PRIFDDINAS.label: Prifddinas
PRIFDDINAS.area: Meilyr district (north-east) of Prifddinas, near the north bank (Tirannwn)
requirements: Quest: Song of the Elves
poi: Crwys district: crystal tree patch, sawmill and Branwen's farming shop
Prifddinas Agility Course (75 Agility), starting at the north bank
Tower of Voices at the city centre

PORT_SARIM.name: Port Sarim
PORT_SARIM.label: Port Sarim
PORT_SARIM.area: Spirit tree patch on the east side of Port Sarim (Asgarnia)
PORT_SARIM.lockedHint: Grow a spirit tree here first
requirements: Skill: 83 Farming to plant (boostable)
Item: a spirit sapling planted here, fully grown (about 58h 40m) and health-checked
Unlock: 1, 2, 3 or 4 trees at 83, 88, 93 or 96 Farming, any number at 99 (boostable; the house tree does not count)
poi: Ships to Entrana (Law Altar), the Void Knights' Outpost and Great Kourend
notes: Gardener: Frizzy Skernip (5 monkey nuts, a monkey bar and a ground suqah tooth to protect the tree).
Just south of the explorer's ring (2 or better) cabbage-patch teleport.

ETCETERIA.name: Etceteria
ETCETERIA.label: Etceteria
ETCETERIA.lockedHint: Grow a spirit tree here first
requirements: Skill: 83 Farming to plant (boostable)
Quest: The Fremennik Trials (for the Rellekka boat, to reach and plant the patch)
Item: a spirit sapling planted here, fully grown (about 58h 40m) and health-checked
Unlock: 1, 2, 3 or 4 trees at 83, 88, 93 or 96 Farming, any number at 99 (boostable; the house tree does not count)
poi: Sea snakes in the Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon
notes: Gardener: Yulf Squecks.
The only teleport onto Etceteria (otherwise the Rellekka boat to Miscellania, or moor at 65 Sailing after Royal Trouble).

BRIMHAVEN.name: Brimhaven
BRIMHAVEN.label: Brimhaven
BRIMHAVEN.area: North-east Brimhaven, near the Agility Arena (Karamja)
BRIMHAVEN.lockedHint: Grow a spirit tree here first
requirements: Skill: 83 Farming to plant (boostable)
Item: a spirit sapling planted here, fully grown (about 58h 40m) and health-checked
Unlock: 1, 2, 3 or 4 trees at 83, 88, 93 or 96 Farming, any number at 99 (boostable; the house tree does not count)
notes: Gardener: Praistan Ebola.

HOSIDIUS.name: Hosidius
HOSIDIUS.label: Hosidius
HOSIDIUS.area: Hosidius, next to the saltpetre deposits, south-east of the Forthos Ruin (Great Kourend)
HOSIDIUS.lockedHint: Grow a spirit tree here first
requirements: Skill: 83 Farming to plant (boostable)
Item: a spirit sapling planted here, fully grown (about 58h 40m) and health-checked
Unlock: 1, 2, 3 or 4 trees at 83, 88, 93 or 96 Farming, any number at 99 (boostable; the house tree does not count)
notes: Gardener: Lammy Langle.

FARMING_GUILD.name: Farming Guild
FARMING_GUILD.label: Farming Guild
FARMING_GUILD.area: Advanced tier of the Farming Guild (Kebos Lowlands)
requirements: Skill: 85 Farming to plant (boostable; the patch is in the advanced tier, which needs 85 to enter)
Item: a spirit sapling planted here, fully grown (about 58h 40m) and health-checked
Unlock: 1, 2, 3 or 4 trees at 83, 88, 93 or 96 Farming, any number at 99 (boostable; the house tree does not count)
Skill: 85 Farming every time you travel here (boostable)
poi: Bank chest and the seed vault
Skills necklace and Farming cape teleports land at the guild
notes: Gardener: Latlink Fastbell.
Below 85 Farming, boost to 85 for every trip here.

YOUR_HOUSE.name: Your house
YOUR_HOUSE.label: Your house
YOUR_HOUSE.area: Your house's superior garden; shown at your house portal
YOUR_HOUSE.lockedHint: Grow a spirit tree in your house
requirements: Skill: 75 Construction (boostable, but not with the crystal saw)
Skill: 83 Farming (boostable)
Unlock: a superior garden in your house
Item: a spirit sapling and a watering can
poi: Your house portal, in the town the marker shows
Whatever you have built: altar, pool, jewellery box, portal nexus
A fairy ring too, if the tree is a Spiritual Fairy Tree
notes: A Spiritual Fairy Tree (95 Construction) works too.
The house tree grows at once and does not count toward the planting limit.
Teleport to House is one of the fastest ways onto the network.

POISON_WASTE.name: Poison Waste
POISON_WASTE.label: Poison Waste
POISON_WASTE.area: Canyon east of the Poison Waste (Tirannwn), by the Poison Waste Dungeon
requirements: Quest: The Path of Glouphrie (part way: heal Incomitatus with the crystal chime)
poi: Poison Waste Dungeon entrance, just west of the tree
Warped terrorbirds and tortoises in the dungeon (56 Slayer; cannon allowed)
Grapple across the river towards fairy ring BKP and Castle Wars
notes: The tree is Incomitatus, healed during The Path of Glouphrie.
The quickest way to the Poison Waste Dungeon.

LAGUNA_AURORAE.name: Laguna Aurorae
LAGUNA_AURORAE.label: Laguna Aurorae
LAGUNA_AURORAE.area: An island in the Sunset Ocean, south-west of Aldarin
requirements: Quest: Pandemonium
Skill: 58 Sailing (to moor at the island)
Unlock: moor at Laguna Aurorae once
poi: Kurask Lair next to the tree (70 Slayer)
Harpoon and big net fishing spot next to the tree
Lantern harpooning on the south shore
Island amenities to build: water pump, cooking range, loom
Locked chest (serrated key: crystal glider's outfit)
notes: Mooring once is enough; you do not have to talk to the tree first.
Aldarin is the nearest port with a shipwright.
danger: Aggressive pygmy krakens surround the mooring point.
Moss giants, leeches and giant mosquitoes live on the island.

portals.label: Prifddinas
portals.description: The elf city in Tirannwn; every way in, the spirit tree included, needs Song of the Elves.
portals.source: Prifddinas (Transportation); surface point: cache 2727 world map, the Prifddinas label (2240,3328) and the four map-link icons (sprite 1535) at the city gates (2239,3270), (2183,3327), (2297,3327), (2239,3384)
